Kit Pricing

Privacy Policy

Effective November 24, 2026

What Kit processes

Kit collects your email address, account and sign-in information, usage and credit records, and information about your device and connection. If you use a third-party sign-in option, we receive the account information needed to sign you in. Our payment provider processes your payment details and shares billing records with us, including payment status and invoice references.

Rex conversations

Rex uses your messages and any project information you include to generate a reply. Kit records your messages and Rex’s replies. Kit’s service administrator can review these conversations to troubleshoot problems, check answer quality, and improve Rex. Keep passwords, payment details, and other confidential information out of Rex chats.

How we use and share information

We use information to operate Kit, sign you in, enforce usage limits, handle purchases, provide support, detect abuse, and improve the service. Kit uses session cookies to keep you signed in. Our service providers may process information for hosting, AI, email delivery, bot protection, authentication, and billing. We may disclose information when required by law.

Retention and privacy requests

Retention depends on the type of information and why it is needed. We may retain records for service operations, security, billing, and legal obligations. To ask about your data or request access, correction, or deletion where applicable, email rex@kitgameengine.win.
